final_message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including both in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

Changes:

- **`src/api/users.js`**: `createUser` takes an optional `nickname` (defaults to `null`). `getUser` returns `nickname`, with `null` when it's missing.
- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js`** (new): adds the `nickname` column to `users`. The `db.insert` call rejects unknown columns, so the column had to exist before the nickname could be stored.

`migrations/` is marked as owned by the DBA team, and 001 and 002 are already applied in production. I didn't touch those files. I did add a new migration, which is the only way to get the column in. Please have the DBA team review 003 before it ships.

I haven't committed anything.
